about.title: About Dr. Bipin Nepal
about.text: Dr. Bipin Nepal is a Kathmandu-based medical professional specializing in transfusion medicine, widely recognized for his contributions to advancing blood transfusion services and research in Nepal. He completed his Master's degree in Transfusion Medicine and Transplantation from Dow University of Health Sciences. He is an active member of the Asian Association of Transfusion Medicine and the International Society of Blood Transfusion.
